clips.title: The story
paras: Across the mountains of northern Lordaeron, Alterac Granite is quarried near Darrow Hill in the Hillsbrad Foothills. Its resilience and grain draw master stonecutters, and King Magni Bronzebeard's royal mason insists on it for a tribute to fallen soldiers.

King Magni Bronzebeard ordered a monument for Sully Balloo, a brave dwarven defender who perished in the tragedy at the Thandol Span. Grand Mason Marblesten, charged with sculpting it in Ironforge, insisted on Alterac Granite instead of ordinary quarry stone. Across the Eastern Kingdoms, few stones are finer. Its legendary durability ensures the likeness and memory of a fallen hero endure untarnished for generations.

Alterac Granite lies around Darrow Hill in the northern Hillsbrad Foothills, near the ruined territories of Alterac. Hostile wildlife, syndicate brigands, and lingering strife make the journey perilous. Bold adventurers must venture deep into contested lands to retrieve unblemished slabs for Ironforge's artisans.
